source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For D332899 at revision 3e22f6ce2506a323aecd485c174f9dab1c3a0298, the reviewer requested a clearer Save-button condition. The AI assessment says the supplied expression omits #canSave in edit mode and would enable Save for a ready draft with an invalid active field. A proposed extraction must retain edit readiness and validity, create-mode required-helper checks, and pending/success disabling. The AI reports passing focused browser tests; the prepared change was not accepted. This is a scoped refactor constraint, not a general style rule.
title: Preserve edit validity when simplifying Save conditions
